name: A New Plague
summary: In Brill, Apothecary Johaan gathers Vile Fin scales for the Royal Apothecary Society's work on a plague. He hopes it will spread beyond isolated victims and reach larger populations.

sections.title: Scaling Up the Contagion
sections.body: Apothecary Johaan's work in Brill calls for more than a poison that harms one target. He seeks a disease that can spread on its own and endure in the wild. So he studies the shoreline wildlife of Tirisfal Glades. The resilient Vile Fin murlocs offer promising material.

sections.title: The Vile Fin Reagents
sections.body: Aggressive Vile Fin murloc tribes trouble Tirisfal Glades' northern and western shores. Their scales hold organic compounds adapted to damp, harsh conditions. Johaan hopes these slick, resilient scales will strengthen the Royal Apothecary Society's new plague and help it endure in the wild.

faq.q: What is the goal of Apothecary Johaan's research?
faq.answer: Apothecary Johaan is developing a plague for the Royal Apothecary Society and Lady Sylvanas. He hopes it will spread across entire populations and lands, striking both the living and the Scourge.

faq.q: Why does Johaan need murloc scales specifically?
faq.answer: Johaan seeks Vile Fin scales for their biological compounds, which may help his contagion endure in the wild and pass between hosts. His early brewing showed that simple poisons lack the complexity needed to spread effectively.

faq.q: Where can the Vile Fin murlocs be found?
faq.answer: The Vile Fin murlocs live along Tirisfal Glades' coasts, especially on the northern beaches by the Great Sea and along the western shore.

faq.q: Who does Apothecary Johaan answer to?
faq.answer: Apothecary Johaan serves the Royal Apothecary Society, an alchemical guild headquartered in the Undercity. The Society answers directly to Queen Sylvanas Windrunner.

faq.q: What is the next step in this quest chain?
faq.answer: After you bring Johaan the Vile Fin scales, he continues refining the formula. He needs more biological components and plans to test the newly brewed strain.

faq.q: Are the Forsaken concerned about using murloc parts?
faq.answer: The Royal Apothecary Society is pragmatic and amoral in its experiments. It harvests local flora, fauna, or beasts whenever they offer the biochemical traits it needs.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you help Apothecary Johaan develop a deadly plague to protect your sovereign realm and destroy your foes.
As Horde, you share a war with the Scourge. The Forsaken pursue their new plague as a weapon against them.
